messages:
maya: Quick sync — final pass on tri-mode landing copy (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need hero variants, webinar hooks, benchmark blurbs, and inbound lead routing. Can we close today?

devon: I sketched 3 hero lines:
1) Ship LLM features that hit predictable latency and cost.
2) Same API. Any scale. Your data, your controls.
3) From dev to production: inference that stays fast and cheap.

sam: Prefer 2 for Private, 1 for Hosted, 3 for Dedicated. Will check accuracy against claims.

lee: CTAs: Hosted: "Try Hosted API — free credits"; Dedicated: "Reserve Dedicated capacity"; Private: "Talk to sales for VPC/on-prem". Visual notes: padlock for Private, spinner for Hosted.

devon: Webinar hooks: A) Live: how we shave 40% token cost across workloads — demo + perf deep-dive. B) Workshop: migrating inference to Dedicated and keeping latency SLOs.

sam: Benchmark blurb draft: "Benchmarked across popular open models: p95 < 300ms; 30–45% unit cost reduction with batching + KV cache vs naive serving."

ops-bot: benchmark-note: internal lab, g4dn-equivalent, 10k requests, p95 reported.

nilesh: Inbound routing: Hosted -> nurture (marketing); Dedicated/Private -> AE queue. Need hidden fields: mode_interest, benchmark_event_rsvp.

maya: Routing mapping suggestion: mode_interest=hosted -> lead_queue=mar_nurture; mode_interest=dedicated -> lead_queue=ae_queue_high; mode_interest=private -> lead_queue=ae_queue_high; benchmark_event_rsvp=true -> tag=benchmark_rsvp.

devon: Form subheads: Hosted: "Start with free credits — no infra changes." Dedicated: "Get capacity guarantees and isolation." Private: "VPC & on-prem options for regulated data."

lee: Add a compact comparison table: rows: Performance (latency), Cost (per-token uplift), Compliance.

sam: A/B test webinar CTA phrasing: 'Join live demo' vs 'Watch benchmark replay'. Place near Hosted hero and near Dedicated/Private blocks.

nilesh: Confirmed with ops: hidden fields are mode_interest & benchmark_event_rsvp; mapping set. Will test form submit later.

sam: Footnote: 'Internal lab, 10k requests, g4dn-equivalent hardware; results vary by model and prompt.'

maya: I'll consolidate and open PR to web repo when assets are ready. Ops-bot: add UTM params (utm_source=site, utm_campaign=tri-mode-launch). Meeting at 4pm if needed. :rocket:
